title: Episode 1
summary: Selwyn returns to Saint Marie and walks into a supposed suicide.
method: The man was killed hours earlier, his body was hidden in an alley for a few hours, and the death that Selwyn witnesses was staged. A trash can was used to fake the time of death.
motive: The killer found out the victim has evidence that his father was intending to commit fraud to take over the Government House property.
killer: The son of a government official, who worked as an intern
notes: First appearance of Sergeant Mattie Fletcher
